text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: synthetic check FAILED: canary 'canary-eu-chat-response' in eu-west-1 is firing (12/12 probes failed). probe id=canary-eu-chat-response-42. details: https://ops.redwood/status/1950001234

pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-1873 fired to @olivia (ack: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-1873)

olivia: ack — I'm on it. pulling canary VM logs and probe traces now.

sarah: thanks, ping me if you need extra hands.

olivia: logs showing repeated TLS handshake timeouts from probe -> canary-host.eu-west-1.redwood.internal
```
[2026-03-14T09:07:11Z] probe: curl https://canary-host.eu-west-1.redwood/api/health -> TLS handshake timeout
[2026-03-14T09:07:12Z] probe: connect() -> -110 (timeout)
[2026-03-14T09:07:13Z] probe: attempt 3 -> ECONNRESET
```

raj: any customer impact seen in metrics?

olivia: preliminary: hosted-api eu-west-1 5xx rate up to ~0.6% in last 5m, p95 latency +200ms for a subset of requests. most traffic retried and fell back, so small but visible user impact (some API calls hit extra retries).

kai: (dns-team) I'm watching authoritative and recursive resolver metrics. seeing spikes in SERVFAIL/NX from a subset of EU resolvers starting ~09:05Z. correlating with your timestamps.

olivia: not a deployed change window. looks network/DNSy. Mitigation plan: 1) disable canary probes in eu-west-1 to stop noisy pages, 2) bump synthetic alert threshold to avoid thrashing while we investigate, 3) netops & dns to investigate route/authority.

oncall-rotation: handing off to @kai at 1950001380 for next 1h.

kai: opened PD incident PD-1873 (linked) and paged netops & dns. tcpdump and dig traces running on probe VMs. starting traceroutes to canary-hosts.

sarah: initiating runbook step: failover real traffic per runbook (non-data-residency customers) to eu-central as precaution. runbook: https://ops.redwood/runbooks/canary-failover

kai: netops reports BGP flap affecting a small set of prefixes used by canary hosts; they withdrew the bad route at 1950001460.

incident-bot: re-running canary at 1950001500...

incident-bot: Canary result: PASSED (12/12) at 1950001500.

olivia: good to see green. closing the page for now — will file RCA with dns/netops notes in #postmortems. thanks everyone for the quick cycle. :thumbsup:

raj: thanks team. please include customer-impact calc in RCA (approx % of requests, duration, regions).

okai: (follow-up) I'll attach tcpdump + resolver logs to the PD incident and flag if we need provider escalation.

olivia: noted — leaving a TODO to revert synthetic threshold after 1h if stable.

sarah: moving to postmortem channel to draft timeline.

incident-bot: PD-1873 status: acknowledged -> resolved (automated) at 1950001540.
